title: NULLIF
description: Learn how to use NULLIF to return NULL when two expressions are equal.

data.text: The NULLIF expression accepts two arguments and returns NULL if the first argument equals the second. Otherwise, it returns the first expression.

data.title: NULLIF basic syntax
data.content: Returns NULL if both arguments are equal.

data.title: NULLIF with equal values
data.content: Returns NULL because both arguments are equal.

data.title: NULLIF with different values
data.content: Returns the first argument because they are not equal.

data.title: NULLIF for blank string handling
data.content: Treats empty strings as NULL in a WHERE clause.

data.title: NULLIF Key Points
points: NULLIF returns NULL if both arguments are equal.
It is equivalent to CASE WHEN a=b THEN NULL ELSE a END.
Useful for handling legacy data with mixed NULL and empty strings.
Avoid using time-dependent functions like RAND() in NULLIF.
